findings.subject: inform/InformSpotlight
findings.summary: The spotlight is a blocking modal with no dismiss control and no scrim click, so it can only be closed with Escape or an action.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-spotlight.tsx:120-160 (scroll lock, inert, focus trap), :132-136 (Escape is the only dismissal), :180-221 (no close button, no scrim handler); dismissable/dismissLabel ignored (:59-69); iOS TipKit tip has a close button (AtomInformSpotlight.swift:9-48).
findings.fix: Render InformDismissButton in the bubble when dismissable (default true), honour dismissLabel, and dismiss on scrim click outside the cutout; add a touch/pointer dismissal test.

verified.reason: inform-spotlight.tsx destructures no dismissable/dismissLabel (lines 62-72), the only dismissal is the Escape keydown handler; the bubble renders no close button and the scrim/cutout has no click handler. Body is inert and scroll-locked, so a pointer user facing a message without actions is stuck. The docs demo (pattern-inform.mdx:36-44) itself relies on 'Escape closes it'.

findings.fix: Fixed by the dismiss control above; add a phone-width story and keep the bubble inside env(safe-area-inset-*).

findings.subject: inform/InformDialog
findings.summary: dismissable={false} does not make the dialog non-dismissable: Escape and outside press still call onDismiss, and the runtime then drops dismiss:"none" messages.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-dialog.tsx:44-53 (onOpenChange always calls onDismiss; only showCloseButton follows dismissable); packages/inform/src/react/inform-outlet.tsx:58-66; packages/inform/src/core/store.ts:73-81; packages/inform/src/core/arbiter.ts:24. The NotDismissable story (inform-dialog.stories.tsx:43-48) suggests it cannot be dismissed.
findings.fix: When dismissable is false, ignore close reasons from Escape and outside press (Base UI onOpenChange reason / disablePointerDismissal) and have store.dismiss no-op for dismiss:"none"; add a test that Escape does not dismiss.

verified.reason: inform-dialog.tsx onOpenChange calls onDismiss on any close (Escape/outside press) regardless of dismissable, which only gates showCloseButton. The outlet's onDismiss calls store.dismiss, which sets the in-memory dismissals[key] even for mode 'none' (persistence.ts only skips the write), and arbiter isEligible then filters the message out for the session. NotDismissable story implies otherwise.

findings.summary: The danger banner announces politely as role=status, and its title colour mixes the danger action fill instead of --a63-text-danger.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-banner.tsx:36-40; inform-parts.css:173-176; atom63 token --a63-text-danger.
findings.fix: Use role=alert for danger, and --a63-text-danger for the danger title.

findings.subject: inform/InformDialog
findings.summary: An InformDialog without a title has no accessible name, and its close button cannot be translated.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-dialog.tsx:75-79 (DialogTitle only when title is set; DialogDescription is not a name); dismissLabel ignored though ui-react DialogPopup takes closeProps (dialog.tsx:116,146-150).
findings.fix: Label the popup from the body when there is no title (as the spotlight does, inform-spotlight.tsx:186-187) and pass closeProps={{"aria-label": dismissLabel}}.

findings.subject: inform/InformBanner, InformCornerFlyout
findings.summary: The inform dismiss control is a 24px target with no 44px coarse-pointer floor.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-parts.css:46-54; iOS uses minTouchTarget 44pt (AtomInformSurfaces.swift:38-40).
findings.fix: Add a (pointer: coarse) rule expanding the ::after to --a63-control-min-target.

findings.subject: inform/InformCornerFlyout (with InformFlyoutStack)
findings.summary: The fixed flyout stack ignores safe-area insets.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/flyout-stack.tsx:45 (offset default 1rem); grep safe-area in packages/inform/src: none.
findings.fix: Default the anchored-edge inset to max(offset, env(safe-area-inset-bottom/top)) and the side to env(safe-area-inset-left/right).

findings.subject: inform/InformCornerFlyout (with InformFlyoutStack)
findings.summary: The flyout exit always slides to the physical right, even in a left corner.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-corner-flyout.css:31-34.
findings.fix: Slide toward the anchored side ([data-placement$=left] negates the translate).

findings.subject: inform/InformSpotlight
findings.summary: The spotlight scrim is a box-shadow, which forced-colors mode removes, and no surface has a forced-colors rule.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-spotlight.css:20-24; grep forced-colors packages/*/src: comments only.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors fallback (an outline on the cutout and a Canvas-coloured backdrop), system-wide.

findings.subject: inform/InformDialog
findings.summary: Choosing a dialog action records the dismissal on iOS but not on the web.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomInformSurfaces.swift:127-132 vs packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-actions.tsx:17-24 and inform-outlet.tsx:56-66.
findings.fix: Pick one rule (recommend: an action closes and records, as iOS) and implement it in InformOutlet.

findings.subject: inform/InformCornerFlyout (with InformFlyoutStack)
findings.summary: iOS draws flyouts as banner-style notices with the close button outside the box, not the raised overlay card of the web.
findings.evidence: examples/ios-demo/Atom63DemoTests/__Snapshots__/iPhone-17-Pro_iOS-26.2/inform.light.png; AtomInformSurfaces.swift:21-60 vs packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-corner-flyout.css:7-18.
findings.fix: Decide whether iOS flyouts should match the web overlay card and inline close.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets
findings.summary: `atom63 docs` strips the live-demo JSX from the inform and widgets pages, and no surface has an `atom63 component` entry.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 docs pattern-inform` and `pnpm -s atom63 docs pattern-widgets` output fragments such as "return ( / {children} / )"; `atom63 search InformSpotlight` -> No results.
findings.fix: Keep exported demo functions intact in the docs-to-Markdown step, and index the inform and widgets exports.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx, @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets, @atom63/brand
findings.summary: None of the four packages has a Themes story, so no baseline shows them in aqua, retro or terminal, and MDX has no dark baseline at all.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__: no *-themes-* file for mdx-, inform-, widgets- or brand-; packages/brand/src/logo/app-logo.stories.tsx:39-41 says so; the 93 mdx-blocks/prose baselines are all light.
findings.fix: Add a Themes matrix story per surface (as ui-react has) and a Dark story for every MDX block; YZ confirms K3 from the contact sheets.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx, @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets, @atom63/brand
findings.summary: The SSR smoke test covers only ui-react stories.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/ssr/ssr.test.tsx:16 import.meta.glob("../../../packages/ui-react/src/**/*.stories.tsx"); only inform-runtime.test.tsx:3,120 renders to static markup.
findings.fix: Extend the glob to the four packages.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx (blocks)
findings.summary: Most MDX blocks accept only className: no rest props, no id or aria passthrough, no ref.
findings.evidence: 24 of 27 block entry files have no ...props/...rest spread (only accordion, tabs, code-block, image-compare spread); e.g. callout.tsx:19, stat-card.tsx:30, timeline.tsx:56, video-block.tsx:36-49.
findings.fix: Spread the remaining root props and the ref onto each block root.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx (blocks)
findings.summary: MDX blocks space themselves with the default Tailwind scale and ignore the density axis.
findings.evidence: Tailwind gap/mt/py utilities throughout packages/mdx/src/blocks; grep density in packages/mdx/src finds only a comment (variants/docs.ts:28); inform and widgets use --a63-space-*.
findings.fix: Decide whether long-form MDX should follow compact density; if yes, map block spacing to --a63-space-*.

findings.subject: mdx/CodeBlock
findings.summary: CodeBlock switches syntax colours with a dark: mode branch, so a dark theme without the .dark class shows light syntax colours.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/code-block/code-block.tsx:81,135; docs/design-system/audits/craft-baseline.json:2-3; AGENTS.md rule 13.
findings.fix: Drive Shiki dual themes from a token-scoped CSS variable set by the mode resolver, and remove the baseline entries.

findings.subject: mdx/CreditsBlock
findings.summary: The credits trigger has no system focus ring and its animations ignore reduced motion.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/credits-block/credits-block.tsx:30-70 (literal durations, no MotionConfig); credits-block.css:1-16 has no focus-visible rule.
findings.fix: Add an outline focus-visible rule, use motion tokens, and respect useReducedMotion.

findings.subject: mdx/ImageCompare
findings.summary: ImageCompare puts ref and rest props on the inner stage but className on the outer figure, and its default transition is a literal.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/image-compare/image-compare.tsx:150,247-255,293-310.
findings.fix: Put ref, rest and className on the same root; take the duration and easing from motion tokens and drop it under reduced motion.

findings.subject: mdx/FigureBlock (with the figure lightbox)
findings.summary: The lightbox trigger name is a fixed English template and its focus indicator is only a fading corner badge.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/lightbox/figure-lightbox-trigger.tsx:24,29-46.
findings.fix: Add a label prop, and draw an outline focus-visible ring on the button.

findings.subject: mdx/PageTableOfContents
findings.summary: The compact TOC trigger name is built with English grammar and the sheet trigger name is fixed.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/page-table-of-contents/page-table-of-contents.tsx:406 (`Open ${label.toLowerCase()}`), :457 ("Open page navigation").
findings.fix: Add an openLabel prop used for both triggers.

findings.subject: mdx/ResourceList
findings.summary: ResourceList fetches every favicon from Google, its landmark name is fixed English, and its arrow does not mirror in RTL.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/resource-list/resource-list.tsx:31 (https://www.google.com/s2/favicons), :101 ("External resources"), :79 (ArrowUpRight).
findings.fix: Make the favicon source a prop (off or self-hosted by default), add a label prop, and mirror the arrow with rtl:-scale-x-100.

findings.subject: mdx/VideoBlock
findings.summary: VideoBlock autoplays regardless of prefers-reduced-motion and always declares video/mp4.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/video-block/video-block.tsx:50,63,70.
findings.fix: Skip autoplay under reduced motion and infer or accept the source type.

findings.subject: mdx/MermaidDiagram
findings.summary: A rendered diagram is a role=img with only a generic name, so its content has no text alternative.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/mermaid-diagram/mermaid-diagram.tsx:283-284.
findings.fix: Accept a description prop (or expose the source in a disclosure) and wire it with aria-describedby.

findings.subject: mdx/PageMeta, Steps, LayerStack
findings.summary: Blocks hard-code heading levels (h1 in PageMeta, h3 in Steps and LayerStack).
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/page-meta/page-meta.tsx:39; foundations/sequence/sequence-block.tsx:29; blocks/layer-stack/layer-stack.tsx:55.
findings.fix: Add a headingLevel (or as) prop.

findings.subject: mdx/MdxPageSkeleton
findings.summary: The page skeleton announces a fixed English "Loading page content".
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/mdx-page-skeleton/mdx-page-skeleton.tsx:45.
findings.fix: Add a label prop.

findings.subject: mdx/prose (mdxComponents, MDXContentProvider, DocsMDXContentProvider)
findings.summary: External prose links open a new tab with no cue.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/mdx-components.tsx:78-87; same in ResourceList (resource-list.tsx:55-58).
findings.fix: Append a visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)" label (overridable) and an optional icon.

findings.subject: widgets/WidgetCard (with WidgetShell, header, title, content, block parts)
findings.summary: The widget title is a plain div, so a widget has no heading and no name; iOS marks it as a header.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/primitives/widget-card.tsx:211-230 vs packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomWidget.swift:87.
findings.fix: Render the title text as a heading (level prop) and label the card from it.

findings.subject: widgets/WidgetCard (with WidgetShell, header, title, content, block parts)
findings.summary: Widget card parts drop id/aria/data props, use Left/Right names, and a deprecated empty export remains.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/primitives/widget-card.tsx:33-37,67-260; primitives/index.ts:8.
findings.fix: Spread rest props on every part, add Start/End aliases, and remove WIDGET_BODY_INSET_CLASS at the next minor.

findings.subject: widgets/WidgetHostedShell (with loading shell, error fallback, transitions)
findings.summary: The in-widget loading fallback has no accessible text.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/runtime/widget-content-fallback.tsx:5-12 (output aria-busy with only an aria-hidden icon).
findings.fix: Add a visually hidden, overridable "Loading" label.

findings.subject: widgets/WidgetGrid and units (WidgetViewport, widget scale)
findings.summary: Widget type is sized from the cell width in px, so it ignores the reader text-size setting.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/layout/widget-scale.ts:25,99-139.
findings.fix: Decide whether widgets follow browser text size (as WidgetKit follows Dynamic Type) or stay cell-proportional.

findings.subject: widgets/WidgetStateFeedback
findings.summary: iOS shows the error description inline where the web hides it behind a details popover, and the iOS state view has no snapshot.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-ios/Sources/Atom63UI/AtomWidgetState.swift:48-73 vs packages/widgets/src/state/widget-state-feedback.tsx:116-118,154-156; snapshots list only widgetCard.*.png.
findings.fix: Align the anatomy (or document the platform difference) and add widgetState snapshots.

findings.subject: widgets/WidgetAvatar
findings.summary: Avatar busy and presence states are aria-hidden and announced nowhere.
findings.evidence: packages/widgets/src/primitives/widget-avatar.tsx:64,85.
findings.fix: Expose busy via aria-busy and status via a visually hidden label prop.

findings.subject: brand/AppLogo
findings.summary: AppLogo cannot be renamed, drops rest props and ref, and paints its coloured symbol with the action fill token.
findings.evidence: packages/brand/src/logo/app-logo.tsx:71-79,87,105; Atom63Logo takes title (atom63-logo.tsx:9-14).
findings.fix: Add title, spread rest props, and use --a63-text-accent (or a brand mark token) for colored.

findings.subject: mdx/DocExample
findings.summary: DocExample tablist name is a fixed English template and arrow keys do not swap in RTL.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/doc-example/doc-example.tsx:90,154.
findings.fix: Add a tablistLabel prop and swap ArrowLeft/ArrowRight when dir=rtl.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx, @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets
findings.summary: No baseline captures hover or focus-visible for any interactive surface in these packages.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__: no *-focus-* or *-hover-* file for mdx-, inform-, widgets-.
findings.fix: Add a pseudo-state story for each interactive block and surface.
